categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing of grinding and cutting tools, including traditional grinding wheels, diamond discs, and recycled wafers. It serves industries such as semiconductor manufacturing, mechanical parts, hardware, steel, glass, electronics, and automotive. The business segments include grinding wheels, diamond tools, and recycled wafers with a focus on semiconductor applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced abrasive materials such as aluminum oxide, silicon carbide, diamond, and cubic boron nitride. Production involves mixing abrasives with binders, molding, drying, firing, dressing, and inspection. For diamond discs, proprietary patented methods ensure diamond retention and wafer protection. Recycled wafers are processed from used test and dummy wafers to reduce costs. The company emphasizes precision grinding, chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) solutions, and continuous innovation in materials and manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include semiconductor manufacturers (IDM, foundries, DRAM producers), mechanical parts makers, steel, glass, electronics, automotive, aerospace, and other industrial sectors. Major end markets are semiconductor wafer fabrication, advanced packaging, and precision machining industries globally. The company has strong relationships with leading semiconductor firms such as TSMC, UMC, Micron, and others.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover Taiwan, Japan, Thailand, the United States, Singapore, China, and other international markets. The company has manufacturing plants in Taiwan (Yingge, Hsinchu, Zhubei, Shulin, Zhunan) and subsidiaries in Japan and Thailand. It actively expands its international presence, especially in Asia and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing abrasive tools and consumables used in downstream semiconductor and industrial manufacturing processes. It also engages in upstream activities by sourcing high-quality abrasive raw materials globally and downstream by providing technical support and total solution services to end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding international markets, strengthening semiconductor grinding capabilities, and promoting lean and smart manufacturing with green and digital transformation. R&D focuses on advanced diamond discs for 3nm semiconductor processes, 17nm recycled wafers, silicon carbide grinding wheels, and new materials for energy-saving and electronic applications. The company aims to be a world-class grinding technology center and enhance intellectual property protection.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of grinding wheels, diamond discs, and recycled wafers. The company also derives income from licensing and technical services related to its products. It maintains a diversified customer base and geographic sales channels to stabilize revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds approximately 35% market share in traditional grinding wheels, 15% in diamond-related tools, 35% global market share in diamond discs, and about 20% in recycled wafers globally. It competes with Korean and American manufacturers in diamond discs and faces competition in grinding tools from various global suppliers. Its strong R&D, patented technologies, and close customer relationships position it as a leading player in the abrasive tools and semiconductor consumables industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$7.02 billion, a 10% increase from the previous year, with a net profit of NT$1.06 billion and earnings per share of NT$7.1. Total assets reached NT$11.05 billion, with equity of NT$7.43 billion, reflecting steady growth. The company maintains strong cash flow and has recently expanded capacity and international presence through acquisitions and capital investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, precision abrasive tools with patented diamond disc technology that ensures diamond retention and wafer protection, reducing customer costs and improving yield. It offers total solution services integrating product and process support, leveraging geographic proximity to semiconductor clusters in Taiwan. Its diversified product lines, continuous innovation, and strong intellectual property portfolio provide competitive advantages and customer trust.
